Amazon scraping on the Apify Store: NanoScrape vs Junglee

The most-used Amazon actor in the Apify Store is junglee/Amazon-crawler: it opens each product page. NanoScrape splits the job in two: amazon-search-scraper reads the search results page (ASIN, price, rating, badges, position), and amazon-product-scraper reads full product pages. Which is cheaper depends on what you need.

Worked example: 1,000 products for one keyword

Free-plan prices (prices from 16 Nov 2026):

  • Rank tracking (ASIN, price, rating, position per keyword): NanoScrape $2.00; Junglee $5.00.
  • Full product pages: NanoScrape search plus product pages = $5.00; Junglee $5.00.

Which one to pick

Pick NanoScrape's Amazon Search Scraper if

  • you track rankings, prices or badges across many keywords: the search card has what you need at $2.00 instead of $5.00 per 1,000;
  • you want positionOnPage and positionOverall per keyword, sponsored slots counted the way a shopper sees them.

Pick Junglee if

  • you want full product pages from one actor in one run;
  • you need offer listings, seller details or a custom delivery location as separate data;
  • you prefer the actor with the most users in the Store (about 4,200 in the last 30 days).
Finding it in the Store: search the Apify Store for amazon search scraper santamaria, or open it directly with the button above.

FAQ

Do I need an Amazon account or API key?

No. Both read public Amazon pages. You need a free Apify account.

Does the NanoScrape price change?

Prices on this page follow the Apify Store listing and include announced changes: the search scraper costs $1.00; $2.00 from 16 Nov 2026 per 1,000 results. The worked example uses the latest announced price.

Can I use both NanoScrape actors together?

Yes. Run the search scraper, then pass the ASINs you care about to the Amazon Product Scraper, so you pay for full pages only where you need them.

Try one keyword first

Run one keyword on the Free plan; 100 results cost about $0.20.
